question: Who among the following is NOT a Bharat Ratna awardee?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Mahatma Gandhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
Bharat Ratna Award__

 __
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest Civilian Award of the Republic of India.
 
• It was instituted on 2 January 1954.
 
• This award is for those who are conferred in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order, without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• The award was originally confined to the arts, literature, science, and public services, as per the 1954 regulations. In 2011 the 'sports' category was included as a special category for a Bharat Ratan award.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi is not a Bharat Ratna Awardee.**
 
 
• He is known as the **'Father of Nation'.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The** first three recipients** of Bharat Ratna were **Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, C. Rajagopalachari, and Dr. C.V. Raman in 1954.**
 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri** was the first person to be honoured with Bharat Ratna** posthumously.**
 
• **Indira Gandhi** was the **first Woman **recipient of **Bharat Ratna.**
 
• There is no written provision that Bharat Ratna should be awarded to Indian citizens only.
 
• Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan was the first foreigner to get Bharat Ratna.
 
• **In 2014**, **Sachin Tendulkar** became** the first and the only sportsperson** and the youngest one to be conferred with the Bharat Ratna.
 
• Bharat Ratna was last awarded in 2019.
 
• The 2019 recipients of the Bharat Ratna award are:
 
 
• Nanaji Deshmukh (Posthumous).
 
• Bhupen Hazarika (Posthumous).
 
• Pranab Mukherjee.
 
 
 
• There is no Bharat Ratna for the year 2021.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• Jehangir Ratanji Dadabhoy(J.R.D.) Tata, Satyajit Ray and Maulan Abul Kalam were awarded Bharat Ratan in 1992.
 
• Jehangir Ratanji Dadabhoy(J.R.D.) Tata **​**__
 __
 
• He is known as the "Father of Indian Civil Aviation".
 
• He founded India's first commercial airline, Tata Airlines, in 1932, which became Air India in 1946.
 
 
 
• **Nelson Mandela**​__
 __
 
• He was also known as **South African Gandhi**.
 
• He was **South Africa's first black** head of state and the first elected in a fully representative democratic election.
 
• He won the** Nobel Prize for Peace in 1993.**
 
 
 
• **Dr.** __**__Bhimrao Ambedkar__ and __Dr. Nelson Mandela__ were awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1990**.
 
• __**Satyajit Ray**__
 
 
• **​**He was an Indian filmmaker, and screenwriter.
 
• He became the** first Indian **to receive an** Honorary Academy Award in 1992 for Lifetime Achievement.**
